column1: # Cases of scripts/interop.sh: each runs for every client against every server.
#   3  client operation; a client that does not declare it is "unsupported"
#   4  flags of the operation, or "-"; --host and the fixture's --unit-id are added
#   5  check: fixture (every model and raw value as the fixture sets it),
#      readback (the write lands and a new scan reads it), refused-unchanged
#      (exit 1, and a new scan reads the fixture's value), refused (ok false)
